reviewPolicy.candidatePromotionRule: A candidate must recur in at least three independent visually reviewed sources and pass one generation replay before promotion to draft.
reviewPolicy.observationRule: Titles, captions, thumbnails, search snippets and OCR are metadata only; action facts require direct visual review.
reviewPolicy.segmentRule: Include applies only to the described reusable segments. Equipment, props, unsafe training, occluded segments and unreviewed tails remain excluded.
reviewPolicy.conditionalActionRule: Actions involving a bicycle or gym equipment must declare required props and environment and cannot enter the no-prop default library.

observations.entryState: Product-only view with no visible wearer.
actionPath: Around 00:08, hands open and indicate a hidden zip pocket in extreme close-up.
Around 00:16.8, a yellow shirt is shown hanging or laid out in a medium-close product view.
observations.notes: Shot reference only. Do not enter either operation into the human motion library.

actionPath: Around 00:13.35, two hands pull blue fabric laterally in an extreme close-up.
observations.notes: Keep only as a material-test shot primitive. Never apply it to a worn graphic area.

observations.entryState: Cyclist rides in a gravel-road environment with bicycle and riding gear.
actionPath: Around 00:13.05, the rider travels away from the camera in a stable rear long shot.
Around 00:35.48, the rider approaches the camera in a very low-angle near-foreground shot.
observations.exitState: Dynamic cycling approach with wheel perspective dominating the frame.
observations.productGoal: Show riding context, dynamic fit and outdoor use.
observations.notes: Conditional cycling-scene candidates only; neither belongs in the no-prop default library.

observations.entryState: Cyclist and bicycle established in an outdoor gravel setting.
actionPath: Around 00:02.74, a three-quarter side ride-by is framed in a long or medium-long shot.
Around 00:20.28, the wearer pauses near the bicycle in a rear medium-close view, making the back graphic readable.
Around 00:42.33, the wearer pushes or guides the bicycle uphill in a side long shot.
observations.exitState: Slow exploratory movement through rocky outdoor terrain.
observations.productGoal: Combine riding context with a readable rear garment view.
observations.notes: Only back_facing_product_pause is reusable without a bicycle. The other segments remain conditional cycling actions.

observations.entryState: Front chest-to-waist view of a wearer in a gym setting.
actionPath: From 00:00 to about 00:02.5, both hands rise near the neckline or shoulders to settle the top.
Around 00:06.9, a low-angle training movement raises both arms and stretches the garment.
Around 00:10.4, the wearer holds a low, front-facing full-body training stance.
Around 00:13.8, the edit cuts to a chest-print close-up.
observations.exitState: Graphic close-up after short training cuts.
observations.productGoal: Pair gym context with a front graphic check.
observations.notes: Only the neckline-settle segment is retained as a conditional candidate. The training segments and red band are excluded.

observations.entryState: Fast gym montage with boxing gloves and strength-training equipment.
actionPath: Around 00:01.6, a woman wearing boxing gloves holds a front power stance.
Around 00:05 to 00:07, a man pauses at the top of a barbell deadlift.
Around 00:11.6, the edit cuts to a face close-up with weak garment information.
Around 00:14.6, an exhausted bent-over close-up ends the sequence.
observations.notes: Training and reaction footage only; do not promote the poses into the default garment library.

observations.entryState: Gym-equipment montage with bent-over and occluded garment states.
actionPath: From 00:00 to about 00:08, equipment and arm positions fold or cover the front garment.
Around 00:14 to 00:18, the wearer enters or settles into a front medium-full view with arms relaxed and the sleeveless print unobstructed.
Around 00:22 to 00:24, equipment operation covers the abdomen.
After about 00:30, face or shirtless recovery footage reduces apparel value.
observations.exitState: Recovery-led close-up outside the garment-action scope.
observations.productGoal: Establish authentic gym use while inserting one clear front graphic confirmation.
observations.notes: Only the 00:14-00:18 approach-to-settle segment enters the candidate pool.

observations.entryState: Several colorful art-print mesh jerseys are arranged on a sofa.
actionPath: From 00:00 to about 00:01.9, only product arrangement is visible and no wearer appears.
Later playback could not be completed in this review.
observations.exitState: Unknown because the remaining timeline was not visually verified.
observations.notes: Exclude pending a complete direct visual review. Caption and duration metadata cannot supply action facts.

observations.entryState: Fixed vertical mirror shot showing the wearer's full body.
actionPath: The wearer adjusts an earring or hair near the mirror.
Around 00:05.3, the wearer settles into a front full-body stance while holding a shoulder strap.
Around 00:10 to 00:11, the wearer walks naturally out toward frame left.
observations.exitState: Natural one-direction walk out of frame.
observations.productGoal: Show complete outfit and relaxed real-world wear.
observations.notes: Include only the front hold and walk-out. Exclude hair, earring and strap actions.

observations.entryState: Fixed vertical front full-body view with arms relaxed and feet lightly staggered.
actionPath: Around 00:00.3, the wearer holds a relaxed staggered stance.
Around 00:06, the wearer makes a small weight shift and light in-place step.
Around 00:09.8, the wearer moves one small step forward and settles into a slight three-quarter angle.
observations.productGoal: Show graphic readability, garment length and natural fit without body-shaping tricks.
observations.notes: Strong body-neutral fit sample. Do not copy the promotional text or arrow overlays.
